Amateur Radio Direction Finding，业余无线电测向，: Amateur Radio Direction Finding, popularly known as "fox hunting".
利用指向性天线（如环形天线、八木）判断信号来向，用三角定位确定位置。: A directional antenna (such as a loop or a Yagi) determines the direction of arrival, and triangulation fixes the position.
常用测向频段，天线尺寸小、方向性好。: The usual direction-finding band: small antennas with good directivity.
环形天线双向性、加垂直振子合成心形方向图，可辨单向。: A loop antenna is bidirectional; adding a vertical element produces a cardioid pattern that resolves the direction.
竞赛中隐藏发射信标的电台，选手依据信号找到它们。: Stations hidden during a contest that transmit beacons, which competitors locate by their signals.
长波测向，需较大环形天线。: Long-wave direction finding, requiring a larger loop antenna.
